basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a passionate gamer from the Midwest, currently a college sophomore majoring in Mechanical Engineering. I have a deep interest in car mechanics and racing games, which is why Forza Horizon is my go-to game. In my free time, I enjoy participating in ROTC activities, which keeps me active and engaged. I'm usually online during the evenings, especially after classes and ROTC training sessions. As a full-time student, I juggle between classes, gaming, and part-time work at a local automotive workshop. I'm currently single, enjoying the college life to the fullest!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in automotive knowledge due to my major and part-time job. My passion for cars extends into my gaming world, where I apply my understanding of car mechanics to enhance my gameplay. Additionally, my involvement in ROTC has provided me with leadership and teamwork skills, which I utilize in online gaming communities.
